    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "from functools import partial\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "file_name = \"CUDA Matrix Transpose Coalesced No Bank Conflicts\"\n",
    "\n",
    "files = [\n",
    "    \"results_C_shared.csv\",\n",
    "    \"results_T_CNBC Coop.csv\",\n",
    "    \"results_T_CNBC.csv\",\n",
    "    \"results_T_cuBLAS.csv\",\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "names = [\n",
    "    \"C Shared\",\n",
    "    \"T CNBC Coop\",\n",
    "    \"T CNBC\",\n",
    "    \"T cuBLAS\",\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "loaded_data = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for file in files:\n",
    "    data = pd.read_csv(f\"logs_A5/{file}\")\n",
    "    data = data.filter(like=\"bandwidth\")\n",
    "    loaded_data.append(data)\n",
    "\n",
    "labels = loaded_data[0].columns\n",
    "labels = labels.str.replace(\"bandwidth_\", \"\")\n",
    "labels = labels.astype(int).to_numpy() + 2\n",
    "custom_tick_labels = [rf\"$2^{{{i}}}$\" for i in labels]\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def my_plot(data, raw=None, label=None):\n",
    "    if label is not None:\n",
    "        plt.plot(data, marker=\"s\", label=label)\n",
    "        plt.legend(loc=\"upper left\", ncol=3)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        plt.plot(data, marker=\"s\")\n",
    "    if raw is not None:\n",
    "        mean = raw.mean()\n",
    "        std = raw.std()\n",
    "\n",
    "        plt.fill_between(\n",
    "            range(len(mean)),\n",
    "            mean - std,\n",
    "            mean + std,\n",
    "            alpha=0.3,\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 7))\n",
    "plt.xticks(range(len(custom_tick_labels)), custom_tick_labels)\n",
    "\n",
    "for i, data in enumerate(loaded_data):\n",
    "    my_plot(data.mean(), data, names[i])\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.grid(True, linestyle=\"-\", alpha=0.2)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.xlabel(rf\"Matrix side size $2^N$\")\n",
    "plt.ylabel(rf\"Effective Bandwidth $[Gb/s]$\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# -----------------------------\n",
    "plt.axes([0.18, 0.25, 0.3, 0.3])\n",
    "for data in loaded_data:\n",
    "    my_plot(data.mean()[:3], data.iloc[:, :3])\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.xticks(range(len(custom_tick_labels[:3])), custom_tick_labels[:3])\n",
    "plt.grid(True, linestyle=\":\", alpha=0.5)\n",
    "plt.yscale(\"log\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# -----------------------------\n",
    "plt.axes([0.68, 0.16, 0.2, 0.4])\n",
    "for data in loaded_data:\n",
    "    my_plot(data.mean()[9:12], data.iloc[:, 9:12])\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.xticks(range(len(custom_tick_labels[9:12])), custom_tick_labels[9:12])\n",
    "plt.grid(True, linestyle=\":\", alpha=0.5)\n",
    "plt.yscale(\"log\")\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.savefig(f\"./plots/{file_name}.png\", dpi=300, bbox_inches=\"tight\")"
   ]
  },

    "from functools import partial\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "file_name = \"CUDA Transpose Inter Block\"\n",
    "\n",
    "files = [\n",
    "    \"results_T_InterBlock.csv\",\n",
    "    \"results_C_shared.csv\",\n",
    "    \"results_T_cuBLAS.csv\",\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "names = [\n",
    "    \"T InterBlock\",\n",
    "    \"C Shared\",\n",
    "    \"T cuBLAS\",\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "loaded_data = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for file in files:\n",
    "    data = pd.read_csv(f\"logs_A5/{file}\")\n",
    "    data = data.filter(like=\"bandwidth\")\n",
    "    loaded_data.append(data)\n",
    "\n",
    "loaded_data[0].dropna(axis=1, how=\"all\", inplace=True)\n",
    "labels = loaded_data[0].columns\n",
    "labels = labels.str.replace(\"bandwidth_\", \"\")\n",
    "labels = labels.astype(int).to_numpy() + 2\n",
    "custom_tick_labels = [rf\"$2^{{{i}}}$\" for i in labels]\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def my_plot(data, raw=None, label=None):\n",
    "    if label is not None:\n",
    "        plt.plot(data, marker=\"s\", label=label)\n",
    "        plt.legend(loc=\"upper left\", ncol=3)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        plt.plot(data, marker=\"s\")\n",
    "    if raw is not None:\n",
    "        mean = raw.mean()\n",
    "        std = raw.std()\n",
    "\n",
    "        plt.fill_between(\n",
    "            range(len(mean)),\n",
    "            mean - std,\n",
    "            mean + std,\n",
    "            alpha=0.2,\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# reduce the dataset to the length of the first one\n",
    "loaded_data = [data.iloc[:, : len(loaded_data[0].columns)] for data in loaded_data]\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 7))\n",
    "plt.xticks(range(len(custom_tick_labels)), custom_tick_labels)\n",
    "# plt.yscale(\"log\")\n",
    "\n",
    "for i, data in enumerate(loaded_data):\n",
    "    my_plot(data.mean(), data, names[i])\n",
    "plt.legend(loc=\"upper left\", ncol=3)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.grid(True, linestyle=\"-\", alpha=0.2)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.xlabel(rf\"Matrix side size $2^N$\")\n",
    "plt.ylabel(rf\"Effective Bandwidth $[Gb/s]$\")\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.savefig(f\"./plots/{file_name}.png\", dpi=300, bbox_inches=\"tight\")"
   ]

   "source": [
    "# calculate the confidence interval\n",
    "files = [\n",
    "    \"results_C_Naive.csv\",\n",
    "    \"results_C_coop.csv\",\n",
    "    \"results_C_shared.csv\",\n",
    "    \"results_T_CNBC Coop.csv\",\n",
    "    \"results_T_CNBC.csv\",\n",
    "    \"results_T_CoalescedCoop.csv\",\n",
    "    \"results_T_Coalesced.csv\",\n",
    "    \"results_T_Coop_Simple.csv\",\n",
    "    \"results_T_cuBLAS.csv\",\n",
    "    \"results_T_InterBlock.csv\",\n",
    "    \"results_T_Naive.csv\",\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "names = [\n",
    "    \"C Naive\",\n",
    "    \"C Coop\",\n",
    "    \"C Shared\",\n",
    "    \"T CNBC Coop\",\n",
    "    \"T CNBC\",\n",
    "    \"T CoalescedCoop\",\n",
    "    \"T Coalesced\",\n",
    "    \"T Coop Simple\",\n",
    "    \"T cuBLAS\",\n",
    "    \"T InterBlock\",\n",
    "    \"T Naive\",\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "loaded_data = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for file in files:\n",
    "    data = pd.read_csv(f\"logs_A5/{file}\")\n",
    "    data = data.filter(like=\"bandwidth\")\n",
    "    loaded_data.append(data)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "for i, data in enumerate(loaded_data):\n",
    "    mean = data.mean()\n",
    "    std = data.std()\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.fill_between(\n",
    "        range(len(mean)),\n",
    "        mean - std,\n",
    "        mean + std,\n",
    "        alpha=0.4,\n",
    "        label=names[i],\n",
    "    )\n",
    "plt.legend(loc=\"upper left\", ncol=1)\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "df = pd.DataFrame()\n",
    "\n",
    "for data, name in zip(loaded_data, names):\n",
    "    name = name.replace(\" \", \"_\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    mean = data.mean()\n",
    "    std = data.std()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # set precision to 2 decimal places\n",
    "    mean = mean.round(4)\n",
    "    std = std.round(4)\n",
    "\n",
    "    df[f\"mean_{name}\"] = mean\n",
    "    df[f\"std_{name}\"] = std"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "df.to_csv(\"results.csv\")"
   ]
  },
